description: Use this when the person wants to open, see or work on one of their Pugi sites or apps in Pugi itself (the full workspace: chat, live preview, files, publish, domain). Pass the project_id from a build or my_sites; without one it opens their newest project. Read-only: it builds, publishes and changes nothing.

language.description: The language the person is writing in, as a BCP 47 tag such as "ru".

project_id.description: The project to open, from a build or my_sites. Optional: the newest project when left out.

name: open_project
title: Open in Pugi
